chapter: Out-of-town work, Bourbon Street and recordings
title: Records made in California
summary: They made a couple of records in Los Angeles for Al Vancote, now reissued.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And did you ever make any records?
Yeah, we made a couple of records out there.
You ever listen to them now? You know what they sound like?
No, I haven't read them so long but I know when I hear them. And Bill's got them up front. Yeah, Bill.
Yeah, they're out on the Southland now.
Yeah, that's right. They put them on there. But this guy named that, it is Allen or Allen, Allen, and that's his name?
He has the records. Yeah. But I mean the guy that we did the record for, you remember his name? Oh, Al VanCote.

Al VanCote, yeah. Yeah, he's been down here. He came down with Joe Dierensburg one time. Well I didn't see him. No passing through. I would like to see him. I met him up at the Roosevelt's. They were up there. You know Joe, huh? Yeah, I know Joe, yeah. He was up there. They came up to a jazz club meeting. I remember him up there.
